opening: The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply.

opening.text: I have a cough with some intense fits. The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply or when I move. I have cancer that has spread, and I'm being treated for osteoporosis. I also drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.
